Restated at replacement capex: BMY spent $3,768mm on plant over 2023 to 2025 against $1,883mm of plant depreciation, 1.33% of revenue above what keeps the plant running. Taken at depreciation, the charge stays nil. Restated without one-off cash: BMY's free cash flow over 2023 to 2025 carried $2,357mm of US transition tax (2023 instalment 567mm; 2024 instalment 799mm; 2025 instalment 991mm). None recurs, so the charge stays nil. Restated without working capital build: over 2023 to 2025 BMY's cash flow statement shows receivables up $1,026mm, inventories up $1,421mm, payables up $380mm, a working capital build of $2,067mm, 1.46% of revenue.
